Summary: Foundation & DevOps
Description: Set up repos, local dev environment, CI/CD, environments, branching strategy, and project governance.

Summary: Backend API (Django + DRF)
Description: Build core backend services with Django REST Framework: models, serializers, viewsets, auth, and pagination.

Summary: Frontend Web (React/Next.js)
Description: Implement user-facing web app with React (Next.js recommended for SEO), routing, state, and UI components.

Summary: Content Ingestion & Metadata
Description: Integrate metadata APIs (e.g., TMDb/OMDb), normalize movie data, and schedule ingestion/refresh jobs.

Summary: Auth & Accounts
Description: Implement secure authentication, verification, profiles, watchlist/favorites, and history tracking.

Summary: Playback & Assets
Description: Handle playable video assets (embeds or hosted), captions/subtitles, and continue-watching.

Summary: UX, Accessibility & SEO
Description: Create a performant, responsive, accessible UI (WCAG AA), and basic SEO for public pages.

Summary: Analytics & Observability
Description: Track user engagement, set up error monitoring and logs/metrics dashboards for services and jobs.

Summary: Admin & CMS
Description: Admin tools for managing catalog, collections, images, and editorial content.

Summary: Legal, Compliance & Policies
Description: Content rights tracking, privacy policy, GDPR basics (export/delete), terms of service, and takedown process.

Summary: Decide metadata API and request API keys (TMDb vs OMDb)
Description: Evaluate TMDb and OMDb for licensing, rate limits, and image usage. Create accounts and obtain API keys.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Decision documented in README
- API keys stored in env (not committed)
- Rate limit notes added

Summary: Decide playable content approach (public-domain archives vs embeds vs hosted)
Description: Select initial playable content sources with clear licensing and a takedown process.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Source(s) chosen and documented
- Licensing notes added to Asset.license
- Takedown steps documented

Summary: Create monorepo and Dockerized local dev environment
Description: Initialize monorepo with /frontend and /backend, Docker Compose for DB/Redis, makefile scripts.
Acceptance Criteria:
- `docker compose up` brings services up
- README: getting started steps
- .env.example files exist

Summary: Set up CI (GitHub Actions) for lint, tests, and build
Description: Add pipelines to run backend/ frontend linting, unit tests, and build on PRs.
Acceptance Criteria:
- CI runs on PR
- Status checks required before merge

Summary: Scaffold Django project and DRF configuration

Acceptance Criteria:
- Server runs locally
- Health endpoint returns 200

Summary: Implement core models: Movie, Genre, Collection
Description: Create models and migrations for catalog entities with admin registration.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Migrations apply
- Admin shows models
- Basic unit tests pass

Summary: JWT authentication with registration, login, logout, password reset
Description: Add JWT auth endpoints and email-based flows; secure password hashing.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Register/login endpoints documented
- Tokens refresh/rotate
- Negative tests for bad creds

Summary: REST endpoints for movies, genres, collections (list, detail, filters)
Description: Implement serializers/viewsets with filtering by genre, year, rating, runtime.
Acceptance Criteria:
- GET endpoints return paginated results
- Filter params documented
- Tests for filters and pagination

Summary: User features API: favorites, watchlist, and history
Description: Endpoints to manage user favorites, watchlist, and playback history.
Acceptance Criteria:
- POST/DELETE favorites/watchlist

- Permissions enforced

Summary: Ingestion worker: fetch & normalize metadata from chosen API
Description: Celery task to ingest movies by ID/query, with rate limiting and caching.

- Command kicks off import
- Records stored with provenance
- Errors retried/backed off

Summary: Scaffold Next.js app with Tailwind and routing

- Pages render locally
- Shared header/footer components

Summary: Catalog grid with search and filters

- Grid paginates
- Filters update results
- Loading/empty states handled

Summary: Movie detail page with metadata and trailer
Description: Display details, cast/crew, similar titles, and embedded trailer if available.

- Detail page loads by slug
- Trailer embed renders
- Similar titles section present

Summary: Auth UI: signup, login, forgot/reset password
Description: Forms with validation, success/error messaging, and integration with JWT endpoints.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Forms validate client-side
- Tokens stored securely
- Redirects after login/logout

Summary: User library: favorites and watchlist pages
Description: Profile area listing favorites/watchlist with remove actions.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Lists render and sync
- Empty and error states covered

Summary: Video playback component with caption support
Description: Reusable player that supports HTML5 and common embed providers; load VTT captions when available.

- Fallback for unsupported embeds

Summary: Accessibility pass for core pages (WCAG AA)

- Axe tests pass for key pages

Description: Meta tags, Open Graph, sitemaps/robots, clean slugs, and pre-rendering for key routes.
